title: Voulchers [93.7 GB Folder of WAR Material]
description: voulchers was a month-long larp orchestrated by an unidentified seller. He led on comm by teasing a "93 gigabyte copy of WAR", saying he was slowly but surely compiling it all into a list in order to set up a GB. He did provide snippets, but only of non-Ye related James Blake loops and poorly done stem edits that were made unverifiable by the tags put over them. He egged-on streamer Auger96 into multiple humilation rituals, getting him to go into public settings to hang up posters advertising the GB and getting people to sign petitions for it as well. Many people became skeptical as he continued to not provide any better quality snippets of known tracks, just supposed unheards. Ultimately, voulchers would be outed as a larper by Egg and mattia, who provided genuine snippets of WAR related material. However. shortly after this mattia would also be proven to be a larp, as his single snippet was one that was being sent around to multiple people interested in buying WAR material by dondasvault

title: YE FIT TANK (H01B)
description:
Background: The YZY GAP Ye Fit Tank was initially planned for release in Spring of 2023 as a part of the Spring 2023 collection. Due to controversies surrounding Ye at the time, the collection was cancelled, and the Ye Fit Tank first appeared in 2024 through 3rd party sellers, which Gap would liquidate to. 

The Gap had debranded these for production and did not put the YZY logo on the necks and covered the YEEZY GAP on the tags with black tape, most likely in an attempt to sell it in the US after the Termination, but backfired after Ye tweeted his Death Con tweet and Gap decided to shut down all Yeezy Gap operations on October 25th, 2022.

In March 2022, Ye wore a series of tank tops that are suspected to be development samples for this.
